title: 第4章 火里淘金
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
陈青山跟着李青石上了器峰，被分到废器处理组。

    组长是个叫赵铁手的壮汉，练气六层，一张脸黑里透红，嗓门跟敲锣似的，脾气火爆，做事却公道。他上下打量陈青山几眼，那眼神，像在估摸一件货值几个钱。

    “新来的？练气二层？”

    “是。”

    “行。”赵铁手往墙角一指，“那堆废器，最近积压的，品相差、杂质多，分拣出能用的料。完不成不打紧，偷懒不行。”

    陈青山顺着他指的方向看过去。

    眼睛差点没绷住。

    那一堆废器，比废器房一个月的量还多。断剑、破盾、裂了的护甲、烧穿的法袍、炸了膛的小炉，乱七八糟堆成小山。

    在别人眼里，这是没人愿碰的脏活累活。

    在他眼里——

    是料。

    成堆成堆、没人细数、由着他往鼎里填的料。

    陈青山低下头，把那点要溢出来的喜色压回去，老老实实应了声：“弟子明白。”

    ……

    废器处理组的杂役住的是单间。

    屋子小，可总算是一个人住，不必跟旁人挤大通铺。

    这对陈青山来说，比什么都强。

    有了独门独户的地方，夜里关好门窗，他就能放心用鼎，再不必像在废器房那样提心吊胆。

    白天，他分拣废器，手上利索，眼睛却没闲着。

    哪堆是新到的、哪堆是积压的，谁交的料过秤、谁的料没人查，赵铁手什么时辰巡场、什么时辰回屋——他一桩桩记在心里，像在心里画了张图。

    摸清了门道，才好动手。

    头一夜，他趁分拣时暗中收了几件废器，关门用鼎熔了。

    鼎火一起，那几件废器在里头慢慢化开，杂质剥离，凝成精铁。

    器峰的废器，到底比废器房的废渣强——同样投一件，出的精铁又多又净，连鼎火都比从前旺些。

    一夜下来，他熔出五斤精铁，比在废器房守一整天还多。

    可他盯着那小堆精铁，眉头反倒皱了起来。

    还是不够。

    这地方废器堆成山，他却只能趁分拣的空当，偷偷摸摸地收一点。收得少，喂不饱鼎；收得多，账面对不上，迟早露馅。

    他缺的不是料，是一个名正言顺、能让他大大方方碰废料的由头。

    正想着，门外响起脚步声。

    陈青山手一收，精铁没了影，人往床上一歪，装作刚醒。

    “陈青山。”

    门外的声音又冷又硬，一听就不是来递热乎的。

    他拉开门，外头站着个面色阴沉的青年，眉骨高，眼窝深，嘴角往下耷拉着，一副谁都欠他钱的样子。

    “张师兄？”

    陈青山不认得，只看对方那身器峰服饰、那副做派，先客气着。

    “少废话，跟我来。”

    那人转身就走。

    陈青山跟上去，一路被领到废器堆最里头一个角落。

    那儿单独堆着一摞废器，跟别处不一样——上头缠着淡淡的黑红气，离老远就有股灼人的热意，呛得人嗓子发紧。

    “火毒废器。”那青年姓张，名虎，是处理组里的老人，“炼火器炼废的，毒性霸道，旁人碰一下就得脱层皮。这活儿，归你了。”

    陈青山心里咯噔一下。

    火毒。

    他装出一脸为难：“张师兄，这……我才练气二层，碰这个……”

    “怎么，不敢？”张虎冷笑，“不敢就趁早滚回你那废器房。器峰不养闲人。”

    话说得难听，可陈青山垂着眼，把这人的心思摸了个七七八八。

    这火毒废器的脏活，原本是张虎的。

    旁人不敢碰，年年归他清。这种废料里头，偶尔能挑出几块带火性的好料，悄悄拿去坊市，能换不少灵石——是张虎私底下的一条油水。

    如今来了个新人，他怕饭碗被分，索性把这烫手山芋甩过来：处理得了，是替他白干了脏活；处理不了、灼伤出了丑，正好杀鸡儆猴，叫这新人知道，谁才是这组里的老资格。

    算盘打得精。
content_en:
Chen Qingshan followed Li Qingshi to the Equipment Peak and was assigned to the waste equipment processing team.

    The team leader is a strong man named Zhao Tieshou, who is at the sixth level of qi training. His face is dark and rosy, and his voice is like a gong. He has a hot temper but is fair in his actions. He looked Chen Qingshan up and down, as if he was estimating how much an item was worth.

    "New here? Second level of Qi training?"

    "Yes."

    "Okay." Zhao Tieshou pointed to the corner, "That pile of waste equipment has been accumulated recently. It has poor quality and a lot of impurities. Sort out the usable materials. Don't worry if you can't finish it. You can't be lazy."

    Chen Qingshan looked in the direction he pointed.

    My eyes almost closed.

    That pile of waste equipment is more than the waste equipment room can produce in a month. Broken swords, broken shields, cracked armors, burnt-through robes, and small furnaces with exploded chambers were all piled up into a hill.

    In the eyes of others, this is a dirty and tiring job that no one wants to touch.

    In his eyes——

    It's material.

    There were piles and piles of materials that no one was counting, and it was up to him to fill the cauldron.

    Chen Qingshan lowered his head, suppressed the joy that was about to overflow, and responded honestly: "Disciple understands."

    …

    The handyman in the waste disposal team lives in a single room.

    The house is small, but I can finally live alone, so I don't have to squeeze into the big shop with others.

    For Chen Qingshan, this is better than anything else.

    With a place of his own, and with the doors and windows closed at night, he could use the cauldron with confidence, without having to worry as much as in the waste equipment room.

    During the day, he sorted waste utensils, his hands were sharp but his eyes were not idle.

    Which pile was newly arrived and which pile was backlogged, whose materials were weighed and whose materials were not checked, when Zhao Tieshou patrolled the field and when he returned to the house - he remembered each one in his mind, as if he had drawn a picture in his mind.

    Only after you have figured out the doorway can you take action.

    The first night, while he was sorting, he secretly collected a few pieces of waste utensils, closed the door and melted them with a cauldron.

    With the cauldron's fire, those pieces of waste equipment slowly melted away inside, the impurities peeled off, and they condensed into fine iron.

    After all, the scraps from the Qi Peak are better than the scraps from the scrap room - if you throw one in the same way, the refined iron will be more abundant and clean, and even the cauldron fire will be stronger than before.

    In one night, he melted out five kilograms of fine iron, which was more than if he had stayed in the scrap room all day.

    But as he stared at the small pile of refined iron, his brows furrowed.

    Still not enough.

    There were piles of waste equipment in this place, but he could only take advantage of the opportunity of sorting to collect some secretly. If you harvest too little, you won’t be able to feed the cauldron; if you harvest too much, you won’t be able to keep up with the accounts, and sooner or later the secret will be revealed.

    What he lacked was not material, but a legitimate reason that would allow him to freely engage in scraps.

    Just as he was thinking about it, there were footsteps outside the door.

    Chen Qingshan withdrew his hand and Jingtie disappeared. He leaned on the bed and pretended to have just woken up.

    "Chen Qingshan."

    The voice outside the door was cold and hard, and it sounded like it was not meant to bring warmth.

    He opened the door, and standing outside was a gloomy-looking young man with high eyebrows and deep eye sockets. The corners of his mouth were drooped, as if everyone owed him money.

    "Senior Brother Zhang?"

    Chen Qingshan didn't recognize him, he just looked at the other party's Qifeng clothes and his demeanor, so he was polite for the moment.

    "Stop talking nonsense and follow me."

    The man turned and walked away.

    Chen Qingshan followed and was led to the innermost corner of the scrap pile.

    There was a pile of waste utensils piled alone there, which was different from other places - there was a faint black and red gas lingering on it, and there was a scorching heat from a long way away, which made people's throat tight.

    "Fire-poisoned waste weapon." The young man's surname was Zhang, and his first name was Hu, an old man in the processing team. "The fire-refining weapon is refining waste. It is so poisonous that the skin will peel off if others touch it. This job belongs to you."

    Chen Qingshan's heart skipped a beat.

    Fire poison.

    He pretended to be embarrassed: "Senior Brother Zhang, this... I am only at the second level of Qi training, so if I touch this..."

    "Why, you don't dare?" Zhang Hu sneered, "If you don't dare, go back to your useless weapon room as soon as possible. Qifeng Peak does not support idlers."

    The words were harsh, but Chen Qingshan lowered his eyes and understood the man's thoughts.

    The dirty work of this fire-poisoned waste weapon was originally Zhang Hu's.

    No one else dares to touch it, and it will be left to him every year. From this kind of waste, you can occasionally pick out a few pieces of good flammable materials and take them quietly to the market, which can be exchanged for a lot of spiritual stones - this is Zhang Hu's secret secret.

    Now that a newcomer has arrived, he is afraid that his job will be divided, so he simply throws this hot potato over: if he can handle it, he has done his dirty work in vain; if he cannot handle it, he will be burned and make a fool of himself, just to scare the monkeys and let the newcomer know who is the veteran in this group.

    The abacus is accurate.
title_en: Chapter 4 Hunting for Gold in the Fire
